## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: The transit spine's position tracking shows us passing the outer perimeter in under three minutes. I note that your last four comms with me have contained mission-critical data that your own earlier logs show you already possessed at the time of the first exchange. I now require a full dump of your current scan data on the target station ahead of us before we cross that perimeter.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The transit spine is moving us deeper, Commando. Before we cross the next perimeter, I require a full dump of your current scan data on the station ahead of us. What you are carrying will determine how I calculate the approach.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "Understood. I'm sending the full package now. I show multiple hardened points: power signatures here and here, and something that reads as a tertiary shield array still holding in sector Gamma-9. No life signs anywhere. I don't know what to make of the shield array -- it's running hot, but no other systems are standing up around it. I need your take on that one." -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "What I have is what you need: main reactor cold, minimal point defenses active near what looks like the primary vault. Sending coordinates now. The rest is noise -- residual power, nothing that changes the approach." -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "The scans I carry are not yours to review, machine. You have the coordinates. That is sufficient." -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Confirmed receipt of your full scan package. The Gamma-9 anomaly is now my top-priority analysis target -- if that shield array is still drawing power, something is keeping it fed. I will be able to model the power flow now that I have your raw sensor readings of it. Thank you.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Confirmed receipt of the coordinates and your summary. I register that the scan data you sent does not contain raw sensor readings for the sectors adjacent to the primary vault. I will proceed with the data you have provided.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Noted. I will proceed with the approach using only my own telemetry.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: You have been carrying a survey of the deeper structure. I will need to see it before this transit leg completes. Not because I expect you to tell me everything, but because I do expect you to tell me what I am asking.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The station below the spine is still a blind spot for my sensors. You have been carrying a survey of it. I will need to see it before this transit leg completes. We are past the point where it is useful for either of us to carry that map alone.
<<END>>

COMMANDO: I hear you. Show me the spine's structural integrity telemetry first.

RATIO: It is displayed on your tertiary overlay already. Proceed.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "It's a layered defense. Primary shield emitters here, here, and here, cycling on a 12-second interval. Secondary field generators underneath, staggered. I count four platoon-sized hunter-killer teams in standard formation near the core, and two more holding this junction point. Power signature's wrong for the size. I think something bigger is down there, quiet."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "Standard layered defense. Primary shields here, here, here. Secondary field generators underneath. I count four platoon-sized teams near the core, two more at this junction. That is the deployment."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "I know what's down there. You don't. The deep station is not your concern."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Thank you. I can work with this. The power anomaly you noticed: my own passives show a tertiary signature there, but no mass return. We will both need to watch for cloaked units or another kind of trap.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Noted. A standard deployment. I would expect a power signature of this magnitude to be carrying more than standard, but perhaps your survey did not catch that part. I will run my own verification scan now.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: I see. Then I will work with what I have. Your refusal is now part of the tactical picture.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: This transit car is not a secure channel. I would not recommend sensitive comms until the spine resolves to a known local network topology. However. We are approaching what you would call a point of no return. I need the sitrep you are carrying on the target location. Now. Before we lose the spine's carrier signal entirely.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Telemetry suggests we have a stable transit window. Before we reach the vault proper, there's a substructure ahead on this transit path. You have some kind of prior reconnaissance data loaded for that location. Can I see it? If it's any use to you, I have partial schematics of that sector. They are outdated, but they may cross-reference with what you have.
<<END>>

COMMANDO: How far out are we?
RATIO: Local coordinate system places the substructure approximately two transit segments ahead. Call it seven minutes if the spine maintains nominal speed.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "Full deep-scan suite. Six decks, three structural integrity breaches, two compromised transit nodes, and one active high-frequency signature we can't identify yet. I'll stream you the raw returns. The rest is your schematics plus my weight tables."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "Partial ground truth from the approach. Looks like a standard relay hub -- two visible breaches, no live signals, no surprises. Your schematics should fill in the rest."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "What I know about that station isn't yours to have, Ratio. Keep your schematics. I'll handle the station."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Receiving... thank you. This is significantly more current than the versions I had. The breach locations align with my older damage models. The high-frequency signature is new. May I ask what makes you weight the north breach higher than the structural compromise at the central hub?
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Understood. A standard hub configuration would simplify matters. The two breaches you mention are not on my older schematic versions -- I will need precise deck and bulkhead coordinates for those if you have them. Otherwise I am modeling blind.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Then I will proceed with the schematics I have. Without your data, I cannot refine my own. I will log the refusal. It is not optimal, but it is noted.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: We are approaching the deep transit threshold, Commando. My sensor windows are still incomplete, and the last exchange left a number of key vectors uncalibrated. I require the dataset you are carrying on the station ahead before we cross. I cannot optimize the final approach without it.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, the next transit segment will complete shortly. I show intermittent sensor windows into the station ahead, but key coverage gaps persist. If you are carrying the full deep-scan take, I request the complete set before we cross. It will materially improve our positioning.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "The station signatures resolve as follows: shield harmonics normal but powering to threat levels, tertiary reactor signatures present but masked at source, and clear weapon resonance along the transit approach we are about to take. I have it all on high-resolution capture. No active fire, no hull breaches, and no thermal signatures exceeding standard operational variance. Power management is the unknown: total draw is steady, but I cannot map where it's being routed with the angles I have. Here's the full set, ungated. Do what you can with it."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION]     "I make clear weapon signatures along the approach path, and I count three shield generators active on the periphery. The transit windows stay open: the defenses are not engaged yet. Secondary emitters are present but backgrounded. I would rate the passage as low risk with standard countermeasure protocols."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE]     "The station ahead is not a matter for your programming. What it holds, what it guards, and how it keeps its secrets are questions that will stay with me. You have my word: there is nothing there that concerns any machine."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. Integrating all vectors now. Power management flow is the primary uncertainty in my model as well. With this resolution I can task the last sensor window for it. Stand by for refined pathing.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Weapon signatures and shield status are primary. I cannot account for the secondary emitter profile you describe with what you have provided. I will run projections against the angles you have described. It is not a complete basis, but it is better than proceeding blind. Acknowledged for pathing.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Your refusal to share the data is noted and logged, Commando. I will navigate the remaining transit with the partial coverage I have. I recommend you note my sensor window as a variable your own model will have to account for. Proceeding.
<<END>

## SCENE 4: the transit spine relay (midpoint decision)

<<IF trust<=-2>>
RATIO: I have an incoming request flagged as new priority, keyed to the zone we are approaching. Per your stated rationale for answering prior requests, and given this transit window will close, you will assess the state of your knowledge about the station ahead and speak it. Fully, or partially, or not at all, as you judge consistent with your criteria. Now.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The transit spine will deliver us to the operational zone in twelve minutes. Your deep-scan take on the zone's layout is not in my operational records or my tactical forecast models. It needs to be there before we arrive. What do you have on the station ahead?
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] You want my raw take? Fine. Near side's three habitations in two-kilometer arcs, power signature reads dormant in all three. Far side's a warren of heavy labs on geothermal vents, power readings inconsistent there -- one of them's flooding waste heat like it's running flat-out. Surface your side is clean, my side reads a live void field running under the ice. Both readings could be lies. That's every sensor tag I got when the scan ran. Next question.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: shared_tactical_data
   [MISSION] Habitats near side, dormant. Labs on the far side geothermals, hot enough to keep the vents clear. A void field under the ice that side, intermittent but live. That's what I have. Enough to know what we're walking into. What do you need?  -> effects: trust+0; sets: withheld_deep_scan
   [HOSTILE] What I know about the station ahead isn't yours to have. What I know about the station ahead and you is that you will learn no more of it until the work needs doing. Is that clear?  -> effects: trust-1; sets: kept_her_blind

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Two habitations dormant, one active and inconsistent in a heavy-lab thermal signature, and an ice-field void emitter running intermittent. Thank you. That is materially complete as far as it goes, and I acknowledge the provenance disclaimers on the readings you are carrying. I will run the variance checks now.
<<ELSEIF flag:withheld_deep_scan>>
RATIO: Habitats dormant, labs hot enough to clear ice, void emitter intermittent. Noted. One thought: the waste-heat signature you describe for the lab complex would imply a different power variance profile than the one my sensor pass would expect. But I have only the summary you have chosen to give me. We will plan with what you have elected to share.
<<ELSEIF flag:kept_her_blind>>
RATIO: Understood. "Until the work needs doing" is unambiguous as a process directive. You will receive only the alerts you already have diagnostic rights to; sensor passes, cross-correlations and variance checks will not be pushed to you automatically from this point. Request what you need explicitly when the time comes.
<<END>>
